_what: what the PI’s §4 unlabelled-surface ruling is worth, in clips
_evidence_class: MEASURED (ours) — read from corpus_status.py’s own output; NO extra load added to Thor, which is running SAM3 inference
_why_this_set_is_decisive: the flag says “no path cell on a NON-DRIVABLE class” — i.e. nothing the map positively calls non-drivable lies under the ego path. The ONLY thing failing these clips is surface that is SEEN but carries NO CLASS. If §4 rules seen-but-unlabelled = compliant, all of them pass cleanly.
_what_it_does_NOT_recover: the 22 GIVEN_UP FAIL-EXPORT-CHECKS clips, which are not published at all and carry different reasons; and the 9 “path untestable (parked / stopped ego)” clips, which are the zero-motion family, not the unlabelled-surface question
_scope: flagged clips ARE published, in a flagged tier. The ruling changes their TIER, not their existence. The projection scales the current count by total/done and assumes the rate is stationary, which is an ESTIMATE, not a measurement.
